source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Service identity, free/open-source status, no-auth access and upstream datasets.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Postcodes.io is a free, open-source postcode lookup API and geocoder for the United Kingdom. It can reverse geocode coordinates to postcodes, find nearest postcodes, requires no authentication, and serves ONSPD, OS Open Names and Scottish Postcode Directory data.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Reverse-geocode endpoint, required parameters and distance semantics.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: GET https://api.postcodes.io/postcodes?lon=[longitude]&lat=[latitude] returns nearest postcodes for a longitude and latitude pair. Each result includes a distance field in metres. lon and lat are required WGS84 parameters.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Fields accepted from a reverse-geocode response and the non-address scope of postcode data.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The postcode response schema includes postcode, longitude, latitude, quality, admin_district, region, outcode and incode. Postcode coordinates are postcode locations and not exact property addresses.
